title: RecommendationInput
description: Minimal input contract for Skill 5 Recommendation. It consumes the structured outputs of upstream skills (do not re-derive them) plus optional hard constraints supplied by the orchestrator/adapter.

risk_analysis.description: Output of risk-analysis skill (RiskAnalysisOutput). May wrap risks under risk_analysis[] or risks[].

candidate_solutions.description: Candidate insurance solutions. Each carries coverage, premium, term, constraints and evidence refs.

knowledge_search_results.description: Output of knowledge-search skill, used to verify product/term facts and ground evidence_refs.

constraints.description: Hard/soft constraints resolved by the orchestrator (from client-intake via adapter). Overrides inferred constraints.
